The Land that Wasn’t There

The Haverlies have forced [he Cransom children to cloak these hills in illusions, but the project has backfired.

=Hooks=

*

What things are in this hex that are obscured by the masses of illusions? What are the more interesting illusions out there?

*

How do outsiders react to the increasingly bizarre and creative illusions that cover this land and that are now beginning to spread beyond it?
